hero_section.description: Interactive particle system with floating resume cards. Use <Points> for background stars/dust and <Float> for the main 3D card element.
hero_section.fallback: Spline embed if R3F is too complex for specific interaction requirements.

skill_galaxy.description: Interactive 3D network graph where nodes are skills. Nodes should glow on hover. Background must be transparent.

universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the 'colors' object for the Tailwind config. Use 'Outfit' for all headings and 'Manrope' for body text. Implement the 3D Hero using React Three Fiber. Use the provided image URLs for the respective sections. Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
